headline: Committee recommends Kahului workforce housing resolution, hears board applicant

meeting.body: Maui County Council Water Authority, Social Services, and Parks Committee
meeting.summary: The resolution supports a future land transfer for about 100 workforce rental units at the Kahului Community Center park site, with details to return to the council later. The committee also heard an East Maui board applicant; a resolution is planned for the August 12 council agenda.
meeting.recap: The committee considered a resolution supporting a future land transfer for part of the Kahului Community Center park site.[[0:13:07]] The project would have about 100 workforce rental units, with preference for health care and education workers and people displaced by the Maui wildfires.[[0:13:22]] Rents would not exceed 30% of a resident's income.[[0:13:43]] The planning deputy director said the administration supports the project.[[0:32:50]] The presenters said the pool and community center will stay with the County.[[0:44:20]] The managing director said the County prefers the homes stay affordable forever.[[0:48:13]] The administration said no land transfer is happening today, and details will come back to the council later.[[0:50:23]] A council member asked for details on charges such as parking, pets and laundry.[[1:12:52]] The committee voted 7–0 to recommend adopting the resolution.[[1:49:20]] The committee heard from an applicant for a council-appointed seat on an East Maui board.[[1:51:14]] The council's deadline to approve a nominee is August 17, 2025.[[1:51:32]] The applicant said he has 40 years of experience in agriculture.[[1:54:48]] He said people should come first when deciding how water is used.[[2:02:37]] He said he sees no conflicts of interest.[[2:23:15]]
meeting.next: The chair said details of the land transfer will come back at a future meeting. A resolution approving the applicant is to be posted on the August 12 council meeting agenda.

moments.q: Developers: a state loan is the largest piece of funding
"Not to have water is not to have life."
